metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the custard, Pope for Gaunt, and four words on the paper.

yesterday: Pope plays Gaunt tomorrow. He waits till the garden in the third act. He will die at Ely House and rise a gardener.
You said he will not get the laugh on this England. The roll stayed with him.
Garnish has cut the long cue.
The Rose has something of a woman and a wonder. You let them have it.
The jaw is still tender. You are at home. Tomorrow Pope has the king.
